name: stri_pad
title: Pad a string on a chosen side

origin.description: Pad on the left, the right, or both sides.
origin.usage: stri_pad(str, width = floor(0.9 * getOption("width")), side = c("left", "right", "both"), pad = " ", use_length = FALSE)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Minimum output widths. The default is 72 under Rscript.

arguments.name: side
arguments.text: Where to add the pad: "left" (default), "right", or "both". A unique prefix is accepted.

arguments.name: pad
arguments.text: Padding text of display width 1, or one code point when use_length is TRUE.

arguments.name: use_length
arguments.text: TRUE counts code points. FALSE counts display width.

origin.details: stri_pad matches side and calls stri_pad_left, stri_pad_right, or stri_pad_both. left is the default. The three documented choices together also select left.

translation.description: Pad on the left, the right, or both sides.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Minimum output widths. The default is 72 under Rscript.

arguments.name: side
arguments.text: Where to add the pad: "left" (default), "right", or "both". A unique prefix is accepted.

arguments.name: pad
arguments.text: Padding text of display width 1, or one code point when use_length is TRUE.

arguments.name: use_length
arguments.text: TRUE counts code points. FALSE counts display width.

translation.details: side is matched the way match.arg matches it, including a unique prefix. left calls stri_pad_left, right calls stri_pad_right, and both calls stri_pad_both. Passing the three choices together selects left. The default width is 72.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.pad import stri_pad
x = stri_pad("ab", 5, "both")
print(f'stri_pad("ab", 5, "both") returns {x}.')
